Consent Form

You are invited to take part in a study about how people evaluate spoken information.

In this study, you will listen to short audio recordings and rate how true you think each statement is on a continuous scale from definitely false to definitely true.

Your responses and reaction times will be recorded. You may stop at any time by closing the browser window.

By clicking I consent, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old, that you understand what participation involves, and that you agree to take part.

IMPORTANT

Read carefully.

The experiment is about the effect of the difficulty of understanding speakers' speech and how that affects how believable that speaker's statements seem.

Listening Practice Trial

You are about to complete one listening practice trial.

Listen to the recording, rate how true the statement seems, and then rate how easy or difficult the speaker was to understand.

This trial is only for practice.
